abstention_definition.empty_set: counts as abstention; its rate is reported separately
abstention_definition.score_threshold_view: a threshold on the temperature-scaled confidence sweeps the risk-coverage curve; used for AURC and selective risk (RQ1, C1-C3, C5, C6)
abstention_definition.set_valued_view: split conformal prediction set at nominal 1 - alpha; abstain iff the set is not a singleton; used for empirical versus nominal coverage (RQ2, C4)

c4_tolerance_band.refutation_rule: if the half-width of the interval on the coverage deviation exceeds the band, C4 is refuted (the deviation cannot be reliably characterized)

calibration_parameters.applied_unchanged_to: every condition and every cohort (never refitted)
calibration_parameters.fitted_on: UTSW calibration split, full-input condition, run 01M46999FB083AX4WW0067YM13
calibration_parameters.procedure: temperature scaling (M2): w = 1/T minimizing mean binary cross-entropy of sigmoid(w * logit) on the UTSW calibration split only; T searched in [0.05, 20]; sigmoid(logit / T)

conformal.crc_secondary_loss: 1[confidence >= tau and wrong], bounded by B = 1, tau_hat the smallest candidate with (n/(n+1)) R(tau) + 1/(n+1) <= alpha (K4, D-045)
conformal.method: split conformal prediction is primary (M5); conformal risk control is a named secondary (D-002, D-045)
conformal.nonconformity_score: 1 - p(true class) on the temperature-scaled probability (D-045, PHASE07_METRIC_CONTRACTS K1)
conformal.quantile_rule: k = ceil((n + 1)(1 - alpha)); the k-th smallest calibration score, +inf if k > n; no interpolation (K2)
conformal.quantile_use: carried over unchanged to every condition and cohort; the refitted-per-condition variant is a reported diagnostic, not the frozen method

missing_modality_conditions.m4_ensemble: five runs, seeds 0 to 4: the checkpoints listed above

operating_points.selective_risk_at_coverage: the smallest attainable coverage at or above the target; the attained coverage is reported beside the risk

primary_metrics.ece: positive-class, equal-width, 10 bins, left-closed, 1.0 in the last bin
